All six supplied candidate branches land in the retained course.

The wider parallel at 18:46 supports enduring righteous deeds against worldly adornment, not repair after squandering, so it cannot establish this candidate's mechanism.

Retain the bounded global contact between the focus's return and the wider wording in 28:85, which places return to a destination beside guidance and manifest error. Exclude the claims of unavoidable arrival and selective rescue from 19:66–72 because no exact surface or HFT trace for that passage is supplied.

Retain the wider contrast between increased guidance in the focus and increased disbelief after faith in 3:90, with 47:17 independently echoing further guidance for the guided. Exclude the claim that 19:73–76 replaces public and material comparison-units, and qualify sustained misguidance, because the packet supplies no exact pericope surface or HFT trace for that sequence.

Retain the focus's linked but distinct operations through their supplied wider echoes: renewed guidance, enduring deeds, and separately framed recompense and return. Exclude the adjacent-context claims about repair, preservation, passage, metric replacement, and divergent feedback because this HFT support has no exact anchor trace and the relevant 19:59–75 Arabic is not supplied.

The possibility that 19:75's مد is respite is an unanchored HFT uncertainty, not an independently assessable trigger here: no exact Arabic or HFT anchor trace for 19:75 is supplied. It cannot establish or overturn a feedback symmetry in the global lane.

Retain a qualified relation between recompense returning to its doer and the final return, with the exact boundary left open. The focus syntax selects recompense for thawaban, so its spatial-return branch survives only as an analogy alongside the focus's return word and the wider return-to-destination wording; the two focus terms are not treated as synonyms.

The proposed provisioned-return analogy has no exact HFT trace or independent wider trigger. Its cited ز و د mapping does not match the supplied focus carriers: yazidu is mapped to ز ي د, and the final return word is mapped by QAC to ر د د. No supplied surface supports a ز و د carrier returning to the focus.

findings.title: Guidance carried into lasting work
findings.claim: The focus's increase can be followed as a course: people already guided receive further guidance, enduring righteous deeds stand as its lasting work, and recompense and return evaluate what comes back. The wider echoes make each contact legible without needing the unsupported contrast with respite.
findings.mechanism: The focus's yazidu and hudan meet the wider repetition in 47:17, where the guided receive further guidance. Its al-baqiyat al-salihat phrase meets 18:46's contrast between worldly adornment and enduring deeds; thawaban meets the reward given to good-doers in 3:148; marraddan meets the return claim in 18:36. Together these contacts turn the increase from a bare quantity into a path whose durable work and return are evaluated.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the growth as directed and consequential: guidance has a continuing course, deeds can remain, and their value reaches back to the doer and forward to return.
findings.containment: The focus's increase, guidance, enduring deeds, recompense, and return remain intact. This finding does not claim that the 19:75 respite is the negative counterpart; the packet supplies no exact anchored reading of that ayah. The wider targets provide surface parallels, not target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run publication is trusted and its six focus carriers are supplied. The wider connection targets give exact Arabic but no target morphology, so the external contacts are qualified surface readings.

The target in 3:90 describes increased kufr followed by a designation of those people as misguided, while 47:17 repeats increase after prior guidance. findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the focus names both who is increased and what they are increased in: increase can deepen a path in more than one direction.
findings.containment: The contrary trajectory does not cancel the focus's promise of increased guidance. The external verses are supplied as exact Arabic without target morphology, and no claim is made that the passages are syntactically identical.

epistemic.reason: The HFT synthesis is unbound, but its bounded positive-versus-negative increase relation is independently supported by the focus surface and the supplied Arabic targets and connection notes for 3:90 and 47:17.

findings.title: Linked operations, separate evaluations
findings.claim: The focus joins growth in guidance to enduring righteous deeds and then gives recompense and return their own comparative frames. Wider echoes touch those relations separately: 47:17 repeats further guidance for the guided, 18:46 sets enduring deeds against worldly adornment, and 18:44 and 28:85 keep reward and return in related but distinct settings.
findings.mechanism: The focus's coordinator wa links the guidance clause to the enduring-deeds clause, while the repeated khayr gives thawaban and marraddan separate evaluative slots. The wider repetitions enter through those different focus relations: 47:17 through guidance and increase, 18:46 through enduring deeds, 18:44 through reward and outcome, and 28:85 through return alongside guidance and error. The contact makes a connected course visible while leaving the focus's clauses as distinct operations rather than stating that one mechanically causes the next.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold guidance, lasting action, recompense, and return together without reducing them to synonyms or a single unspoken cause-and-effect chain.
findings.containment: This does not deny a trajectory reading of the focus. It keeps the causal relation open and excludes the HFT's adjacent-context claims about repair, preservation, passage, metric replacement, and divergent feedback because those 19:59–75 surfaces are not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The broad HFT summary is unbound and has no anchor trace. The retained distinction is checked against the focus connectors and exact Arabic in the supplied wider connections, whose target morphology is unavailable.

findings.title: Recompense and return as paired frames
findings.claim: The focus places recompense and final return under repeated better-value comparisons. Wider wording keeps them in contact without making them the same: 18:44 pairs reward with outcome, 3:148 gives reward to good-doers, and 28:85 places return to a destination beside guidance and error. The exact boundary between a yielded consequence and a return endpoint remains open.
findings.mechanism: The carrier thawaban locally names recompense, while marraddan names the focus's final return. The outside pair in 18:44 distinguishes recompense from outcome; 3:148 makes the reward's recipients visible as doers; and 28:85 brings a return destination into contact with guidance and error. These separate contacts let the recompense's returned-to-doer sense and the final endpoint echo one another while the spatial-return branch on thawaban remains only analogical.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why the two final comparisons are adjacent yet not redundant: one evaluates what comes back to the doer, the other where the course returns.
findings.containment: The focus grammar selects reward for thawaban, so its spatial-return branch is retained only as an analogy and does not replace recompense. No exact root or morphology is assigned to the external targets, and the porous boundary is not resolved into one meaning.

epistemic.reason: The HFT summary is legacy_unbound and has no exact trace. The paired reading is independently checked against the focus QAC carriers and supplied exact Arabic in 18:44, 3:148, and 28:85; target morphology is unavailable and the thawaban return sense remains analogical.
